newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Lower Chamber of Deputies debates simple motion on new tax road lodged by the main opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR).

* The Bucharest water utility signed a contract worth $50 million with Italian and Frech companies to replace 90 km of water mains. Half of the cost will be paid from World Bank loans, the state radio said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
